title: seekTo() not work on Data Uri scheme
body:
### [REQUIRED] Issue description

seekTo() may not work for Data Uri scheme.

- For any reasion, I want to use music data on memory. (Not streaming/ Not local path Loading)
- But, ExoPlayer does not have any arg for binary data on memory (like AVAudioPlayer.Init(Data) in iOS).
- So, I use data uri scheme for using data on memory. (It use url like data:audio/mpeg;base64,abcdefghijklmno... <= url include sound data)

It can play and pause and getCurrentPosition(). But, can not work seekTo() correctly.

- If I use seekTo(3,000), 
  - can change getCurrentPosition() correctly, 
  - But play music on about 52,000 mSec.
- If I use seekTo(0), 
  - can change getCurrentPosition() correctly, 
  - But play music on about 52,000 mSec too.

- And secondly, calling seekTo() go about 104,000 mSec even if any arg mSec.


#### Question

- Can you change these?
- Can I avoid these ?
- Can I use exoPlayer with music data on memory data like AVAudioPlayer.Init(Data)(in iOS) instead of Data uri scheme?


### [REQUIRED] Reproduction steps

- set next data uri scheme to MediaSource like 

```
        dataSourceFactory = new DefaultDataSourceFactory(context, userAgent);
```
```
        MediaSource source = new ProgressiveMediaSource.Factory(dataSourceFactory).createMediaSource(uri);
        exoPlayer.prepare(source);
        exoPlayer.setPlayWhenReady(true);
```
```
        exoPlayer.seekTo(milliSec);
```


### [REQUIRED] Link to test content

- next is data uri scheme sample 
- (bear.mp3 on exoplayer repository)


```
data:audio/mpeg;base64,
```

### [REQUIRED] A full bug report captured from the device

nothing any bug log report.

### [REQUIRED] Version of ExoPlayer being used
2.10.1
exoplayer-core only used

### [REQUIRED] Device(s) and version(s) of Android being used

- HTC nexus 9 (android version 5.1.1)
- I am checking another devices.
